knowledge_graph.title: The Income-tax Act, 1961
knowledge_graph.description: The Income Tax Act, 1961 is the charging statute of income tax in India. It provides for the levy, administration, collection, and recovery of income tax. The Government of India brought a draft statute called the Direct Taxes Code intended to replace the Income Tax Act, 1961 and the Wealth Tax Act, 1957.

related_questions.question: What is total income under the Income Tax Act 1961?
